text.p: The extraordinary shareholder meeting of leading Latvian bank Unibanka has been postponed to June 2, the central depository said on Thursday.
Depository president Martinsh Rikshis told a news conference about the postponement of the meeting.

"The Unibanka board announces that following the suggestion of large shareholders and supported by the council, the extraordinary shareholder meeting of the 21st should be postponed to June 2," Rikshsis said.

The extraordinary meeting had been scheduled to discuss the merger of Unibanka and Zemes Banka. However, the planned merger was cancelled by the two banks after they decided that the synergies of the merger were not as big as thought.
However, the Latvian Privatisation Agency, which controls the state's 33 percent share in Unibanka, was angered by the cancelled merger and has said it should go ahead.
The big shareholders in Unibanka apart from the state are the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and Swedfund.
